title: 第十二章 一个非常大胆的想法
slug: 次元法典全本免费-次元法典最新章节列表
content_zh:
在暗黑的世界之中，方正所看见的，只有无边的黑暗。哪怕是在白天，压在你头顶的乌云也好像是一块巨大的棺材盖子，让人喘不过气来。放眼望去，四周除了荒野就是黑暗的丛林，待得时间长了，甚至会有一种整个世界即将在自己眼前毁灭的错觉。荒凉，黑暗，绝望，那就是暗黑世界的主题。至于希望？这东西或许存在，但是它存在的意义，也仅仅只是为了被毁灭而已。
但是在主世界，方正所看见的，却是另外一幅模样。
“就是这里？”
坐在马车里，方正望向眼前的城市，从这具身体的原主人那里，方正得知这座城市名叫卡尔图斯，在精灵语中是“星月闪耀之处”，而这个国家的人们对这座城市的统称为“星月城”。
这只是一座位于圣教之国内的小城，但是即便如此，它在方正眼中也足以展现出与众不同之处———高达近二十米，由白石堆砌而成的城墙围绕着整个城市，一条美丽的河流从城市中间横跨而过，为这座城市带来了美丽的湖泊与丰饶的渔业资源。
“是的，大人，这里就是星月城。”
听到方正的询问，负责驾驶马车的车夫笑嘻嘻的开口说道，而方正则是意味深长的望了一眼那位于城中的白色圣殿。接着他再次看向自己面前的次元法典。
【执行者：方正】
【次元点数：5】
【装备灵魂石：阿尔萨斯】
【获得增益：不死的王者（对不死生物感应提升50%，对不死生物伤害提升50%，对不死生物防护提升50%）】
【佩戴头衔：神圣守护者】
【力量：E（提刀杀鸡还是没有问题的）】
【敏捷：D（跑的比别人快总是能长命的）】
【体质：E（人被杀，就会死）】
【感知：D（眼观六路耳听八方对你来说是基本操作）】
【魅力：D （颜值是能够加强彼此交流和理解的基本要素）】
【装备技能：皇家十字剑术（A）】
在仔细看了一眼自己的信息栏之后，方正深吸了口气。
“我们走。”

“是。”
很快，马车再次启程，向前驶去。
“呼…………”
坐在马车里，方正深吸了口气，闭上眼睛，开始稳定自己的心神。离开暗黑世界之后他计算过时间，自己在暗黑世界里待了三天，而在主世界只过去了不到十个小时。幸运的是对方没有死心眼的派人守着他，不然方正还真不一定能够跑出来。
在离开森林之后，方正所做的第一件事就是去附近一个村落里换掉了自己的衣服，然后雇佣了一辆马车前往最近的城市。让方正松了口气的是，在那个村落里他并没有看见关于自己这具身体原本主人的通缉令。或许对方现在还没有放弃对他的搜捕，可是一旦搜索无果绝对会立刻下达通缉令，这点儿方正是绝对不会有所怀疑的。这个世界虽然表面上看起来不过只是普通的中世纪水准，但事实上方正所拥有的记忆告诉他，这个世界之中单纯论文明水平，恐怕不比自己重生之前的那个世界差到哪儿去。
考虑到那些恐怖的高端武力，说不定还犹有过之。
毕竟在方正的世界，除了核弹之外很难有什么东西可以毁灭一个星球的。
在来到这座城市前，方正已经完全消化了自己这具躯体的记忆，同时，他也想好了自己要做什么。
逃是不可能的，圣教之国萨雷斯是这个世界最强大的四个国家之一，剩下的三个国家分别是魔导之国莱昂和财富之国卡隆。其中魔导之国是属于法师的国家，而财富之国则是商人与贵族们的天堂，剩下的最后一个国家，则是火焰之国梵瑞尔。
根据方正这具身体主人的记忆，圣教之国萨雷斯占据了这片大陆近五分之一的土地，拥有强大的军队以及圣职者。而圣教之国之所以能够拥有如此的地位，是因为在千年前的“混沌之潮”中，这个国家的国王以一己之力带领人类突破了黑暗与混沌的毁灭封锁，最终守护了这个世界。因此圣教之国便以“人类守护者”的身份成为了这片土地的主人。而它所占据的土地与人口，和方正重生之前自己的国家几乎没什么区别，可以想象，面对这样一个人口众多，又占据辽阔土地的国家，方正根本不可能有任何胜算。

content_en:
In the dark world, all Fang Zheng saw was boundless darkness. Even in the daytime, the dark clouds pressing above your head are like a huge coffin lid, making people breathless. Looking around, there is nothing but wilderness and dark jungle. If you stay there for a long time, you may even have the illusion that the entire world is about to be destroyed before your eyes. Desolation, darkness, and despair are the themes of the dark world. As for hope? This thing may exist, but the meaning of its existence is only to be destroyed.
But in the main world, what Fang Zheng saw was completely different.
"Is this right here?"
Sitting in the carriage, Fang Zheng looked at the city in front of him. From the original owner of this body, Fang Zheng learned that the city's name was Kartus, which in the Elvish language means "the place where the stars and moon shine", and people in this country collectively called this city "Star and Moon City".
This is just a small city located within the Holy Church, but even so, it is distinctive enough in Fang Zheng's eyes - a city wall nearly twenty meters high and made of white stones surrounds the entire city. A beautiful river runs across the middle of the city, bringing beautiful lakes and rich fishery resources to the city.
"Yes, sir, this is Xingyue City."
Upon hearing Fang Zheng's inquiry, the driver responsible for driving the carriage said with a smile, while Fang Zheng glanced meaningfully at the white temple located in the city. Then he looked at the dimensional code in front of him again.
[Executor: Fang Zheng]
[Dimension points: 5]
[Equip Soul Stone: Arthas]
[Gain gain: King of the Undead (sensitivity against undead creatures increased by 50%, damage against undead creatures increased by 50%, protection against undead creatures increased by 50%)]
[Wear title: Holy Guardian]
[Strength: E (there is no problem in killing chickens with a knife)]
[Agility: D (running faster than others can always live longer)]
[Physique: E (if someone is killed, he will die)]
[Perception: D (seeing in six directions and hearing in all directions is a basic operation for you)]
[Charm: D (appearance is the basic element that can enhance mutual communication and understanding)]
[Equipment Skill: Royal Cross Swordsmanship (A)]
After taking a closer look at his information column, Fang Zheng took a deep breath.
"Let's go."
"Yes."
Soon, the carriage started again and drove forward.
"Huh..."
Sitting in the carriage, Fang Zheng took a deep breath, closed his eyes, and began to stabilize his mind. After leaving the dark world, he calculated the time and found that he had been in the dark world for three days, but less than ten hours had passed in the main world. Fortunately, the other party didn't send people to guard him, otherwise Fang Zheng might not be able to escape.
After leaving the forest, the first thing Fang Zheng did was to change out of his clothes in a nearby village, and then hired a carriage to go to the nearest city. What made Fang Zheng relieved was that he did not see a wanted notice for the original owner of his body in that village. Maybe the other party hasn't given up on hunting him yet, but if the search turns out to be fruitless, they will definitely issue a wanted order immediately. Fang Fang will never doubt this. Although this world looks like an ordinary medieval one on the surface, in fact the memory that Fang Zheng possesses tells him that the level of civilization in this world is probably no worse than the world before his rebirth.
Considering those terrifying high-end weapons, maybe it's even worse.
After all, in Founder's world, it is difficult for anything other than nuclear bombs to destroy a planet.
Before coming to this city, Fang Zheng had completely digested the memory of his body, and at the same time, he had also thought about what he wanted to do.
Escape is impossible, the holy religionSareth is one of the four most powerful countries in the world. The remaining three countries are Leon, the country of magic, and Caron, the country of wealth. Among them, the Kingdom of Magic is a country belonging to mages, while the Kingdom of Wealth is a paradise for merchants and nobles. The last remaining country is Vanriel, the Kingdom of Fire.
According to the memory of the owner of Fang Zheng's body, Sares, the Holy Kingdom, occupies nearly one-fifth of the land on this continent and has a powerful army and priests. The reason why the Kingdom of the Holy Religion has such a status is because during the "Tide of Chaos" thousands of years ago, the king of this country single-handedly led mankind to break through the destructive blockade of darkness and chaos, and ultimately protected the world. Therefore, the Kingdom of the Holy Religion became the master of this land as the "Guardian of Humanity". The land and population it occupies are almost the same as those of Fang Zheng's own country before his rebirth. It is conceivable that facing such a country with a large population and a vast land, Fang Zheng has no chance of winning.
